topic: Research: Grok Build Review 2026: xAI Terminal Coding Agent vs Claude Code and Codex CLI

key_points: Early beta announcement positions Grok Build as an xAI terminal coding agent for complex professional engineering work.
Plan mode introduced for complex tasks with explicit user approval for plans/steps before execution.
Install path is subscription-gated (`curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash`).
Active changelog with near-daily fixes/features from May through June 2026.
Shows strong velocity focus on terminal UX, tool reliability, and MCP/tool-call stability.
Includes explicit versioning (e.g., Grok Build 0.2.73 on Jun 28, 2026).
Introduced `grok-build-0.1` as an API model specifically trained for agentic coding and MCP support.
Claims 100+ tokens/sec and pricing `$1/m in` and `$2/m out` for API usage.
Positions the model as the same one powering Grok Build CLI.
Codex CLI is positioned as a lightweight terminal coding agent that edits local repos and runs local developer tooling.
Offers interactive and workflow-oriented modes with explicit user control over model, permissions, and command execution.
Install channels include standalone installer (`curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh`) and common package paths.
Claude Code emphasizes repo-aware terminal execution on your local machine with optional enterprise-managed release channels.
Supports update channels and package-manager workflows for controlled rollout in organizations.
Documents explicit upgrade and permission/update behavior for stable vs latest channels.

stats.fact: Grok Build 0.1 pricing in API beta: $1 per million input tokens and $2 per million output tokens.
Grok Build 0.1 claims throughput around 100+ tokens/sec for coding workloads in API mode.
OpenAI Codex repo has ~96,675 stars and ~14,345 forks (GitHub API), indicating broad ecosystem engagement.
Anthropic Claude Code repo has ~137,083 stars and ~22,042 forks (GitHub API).
OpenAI Codex latest release in this snapshot is `rust-v0.144.1`, published 2026-07-09.
Claude Code latest release in this snapshot is `v2.1.205`, published 2026-07-08.
OpenAI Codex npm weekly downloads: ~10,625,797 (last week ending 2026-07-08).
Claude Code npm weekly downloads: ~11,482,894 (last week ending 2026-07-08).
xAI Grok package package `@xai-official/grok` weekly downloads are comparatively low at ~18,773 in same window.
xAI Grok Build changelog has active entries through at least Jun 28, 2026 and rapid patch cadence.

angles: Gating and packaging strategy: Grok Build’s subscription-limited CLI access contrasts with the broader availability models used by Codex and Claude.
Release velocity appears highest for Grok Build, while Codex and Claude are tracking steady cadence at enterprise-grade intervals.
Operational placement differs: Claude Code is aggressively local-first by design, while Codex exposes both local-terminal workflows and broader ChatGPT/Codex surfaces.

Model strategy may become a clearer differentiator than UI: grok-build-0.1 is positioned as dedicated coding model whereas Codex/Claude are tightly tied to parent provider model stacks and enterprise channels.
A practical 2026 winner narrative is likely task-fit based: plan/approval control in Grok, cross-project review workflows in Codex, and enterprise managed settings in Claude.
